comment: In LFO mode the oscillator is switched to unipolar (Bend.cpp:88) and the wave tables are offset by one before being scaled by five, so the square, sine and triangle outputs run 0V to 10V rather than -5V to 5V. The noise output is not affected. The census spells the frequency modulation input "Fequency modulation", which is the maker's own typo in the tooltip (Bend.cpp:84). The glide calculator treats anything below 0.02 on the slider as no glide at all (BendGlideCalculator.cpp:14-17).
